<b>Skullwings</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are airborne relatives of the [[Skull Scuttlers]], only found in [[the Marrow]]'s deepest and hottest caves.<ref>Skullwing [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Airborne relative of the grounded Skull Scuttler, found only in the Marrow's deepest, hottest caves."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skullwings have no attacks, instead hovering in place and dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. When killed, another flies in after a short period of time, except for the two found in the room following [[the Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] escape sequence.

Skullwings mainly serve as platforming elements for [[Needle]] bounces or the [[Clawline]]. [[Cogflies]] do not attack them, and the [[Wispfire Lantern]] does not spawn [[Wisp]]s if a Skullwing is nearby, but [[Pale Nails]] still target them.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
*Rumbling, crackling...
*Shells are strong...
*Scratching, seeking...
*Warm and dark...
*Digging, hiding...
*Claws are sharp...
}}

== Location ==
Skullwings can be found primarily in a part of the Marrow connected to [[Weavenest Atla]], specifically in the area where the [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]] is obtained.

Some Skullwings also serve as targets for the [[Clawline]] or [[Needle]] bounce during the escape sequence after visiting [[the Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] for the first time.
